name: MomentumTestimonials - Photo-Led Rows
description: The impact band as the campaign design draws it: alternating photo and quote rows on aqua, under a kicker, a serif heading, and a slotted lede. The two quotes are deliberately unequal — the first carries a portrait and the second does not, which is the production state, because there is no photo on file for Mohammed Ally and the card renders without one rather than borrowing a face that is not his. A frame where both had portraits would hide the case that actually ships.
